name: Explorable
line: One reading column of Alegreya on fine graph paper, annotated like a working notebook: highlighter strokes, red-pencil circles, underlines and a few Caveat margin notes draw themselves as each passage reaches the reading line, and the lesson becomes two 1,000-dot figures (smokers and lifelong non-smokers) that light up when you point at the figures in the text.
notes: The four margin notes only paraphrase the page's own content (for example 'how sure — not how big', 'every entry names its sources'). The dot figure is an inline SVG drawn from the CONTENT.md figures: 100 filled and 20 open dots for smokers, 4 filled and 1 open for lifelong non-smokers. Notes sit in a right margin on wide screens and fold into the column below 1120 px. Without JavaScript or with reduced motion every mark is simply shown. Alegreya, Alegreya Sans and Caveat all cover Cyrillic; Chinese falls back to system fonts.
